rules.claim: CollectTargets walks build.GetType().GetInterfaces() to discover Target-typed properties (default interface members), not only class members.
Ambiguity is fail-closed: two different interfaces contributing the same target name with no class override is an error at collection time naming both sources.
Components inject values via IHaz* abstract interface properties satisfied by the build, not via an ambient service locator like this.Require<T>().
Rejected: an ambient this.Require<T>() service locator for component injection.
Tamp.Components depends only on Tamp.Core and keeps SDK/tool coupling out of the reusable contracts.
SDK-coupled concrete component bodies live in Tamp.Components.NetCli.V{N}, following the Tamp.{Family}.V{N} naming convention.
